run_make_dataset_public: run the script to generate a public zip archive of a BOP dataset test split
configure_dataset_params: configure the dataset name, split, and targets filename parameters in the script
filter_images_by_targets: filter RGB images by BOP test targets to include only selected scene-image pairs
create_public_zip: create a deflated zip archive containing scene camera data and filtered RGB images
load_targets_json: load estimation targets from a JSON file and organize them by scene and image ID
